files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.AnnounceReason
files.Summary: Why an assistant is about to speak on its own ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.AssistantActivity
files.Summary: What the module is busy with, besides its state: what a character may show it doing.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.AssistantState
files.Summary: States the module tells the assistant about; each assistant shows them its own way.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.CaptionButtons
files.Summary: The minimize, maximize/restore and close buttons of a window, when they can be found.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.CommonSettings
files.Summary: The settings every assistant has the same way ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.EntranceKind
files.Summary: Why an assistant comes onto the desktop ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.ExitKind
files.Summary: Why an assistant leaves the desktop ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.ExtraState
files.Summary: How one of its extras shows in its menu and its panel ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.ActivateWindow
files.Summary: Bring a window to the front (perch on it, knock on the door…). Commit when it should happen.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.Announce
files.Summary: it is about to say something on its own (a timer that rang, «avísame cuando» that happened, «Asistente: decir»), so it catches the user's eye first: it comes closer to the cursor, waves, blinks… The host waits for it (at most , about 2 s; half a second in «Fast») and then speaks with : end as soon as it is done. Nothing to Commit.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.Communicate
files.Summary: The generic one: stay visible while the host shows Text in the bubble.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.GoTo
files.Summary: Go somewhere (fly, walk, teleport).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.Mark
files.Summary: Leave a mark somewhere for a while (beacon, flag, alarm clock), with an optional label.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.MoveWindow
files.Summary: Move a window to Destination. Either move it frame by frame with and return (K-Desktop then puts it exactly in place), or call Commit and let the module move it. If Window is maximized it arrives already restored by a previous PressButton(Restore).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.PointAt
files.Summary: Point at a window, a point or an area (a spotlight, an arm…).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.PressButton
files.Summary: Press a caption button. Call at the moment of the effect (when the shot hits): the window minimizes right then.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.React
files.Summary: A short reaction to how something went. says where it comes from, how many in a row and whether it is the first of the day, so the same reaction need not look the same every time.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.Scan
files.Summary: Sweep an area (screenshot, reading the screen).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.Typing
files.Summary: Pretend to type into a window (keys or text are being sent to it).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture.WaitForWindow
files.Summary: Something was just opened: wait for its window. completes with the new window (or null when it does not show up in time).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Gesture
files.Summary: What the module wants to achieve; the assistant decides how. An assistant that only knows and already works: for the rest the module falls back to Communicate and performs the action itself.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.GestureKind
files.Summary: The gesture names, as listed in the «gestures» of the «traits» of assistant.json (camelCase there: "pointAt", "pressButton"…).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.HitShape.Polygon
files.Summary: Any polygon (a rotated body, for example).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.HitShape
files.Summary: The shape of a hit area, in screen pixels.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IAssistant
files.Summary: An assistant: a character that lives on the desktop. The host (K-Desktop's assistant process) loads it from its package, gives it the world and its services, and asks it for gestures; the assistant never sees the AI, the tools, the pipe or K-Desktop.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IAssistantHost
files.Summary: Everything the host offers an assistant. Use it from the engine thread unless a member says otherwise.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IAssistantLog
files.Summary: Its lines go to K-Desktop's assistant log, prefixed with its id.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IAudio
files.Summary: Sound. The host mixes everything and applies the user's volume for assistants.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IGestureContext
files.Summary: What the module gives an assistant while it performs a gesture.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IKeyboard
files.Summary: The keyboard, for assistants with a manual mode (the Lander's game). Reading the state is always allowed; capturing keys makes K-Desktop swallow them so the application in front does not get them as well.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IPointer
files.Summary: The mouse. The overlay lets every click through; to be clickable an assistant places hit areas over its body (invisible windows with that shape). Their events arrive at . The right button is the host's: it opens the assistant menu (talk, write, extras, settings…).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IRendering
files.Summary: Drawing services. The host keeps one transparent overlay over every monitor that never takes the mouse or the focus; each surface is a small canvas on it that the compositor moves for free.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.ISurface
files.Summary: A canvas on the overlay. Call only when something changed: the last frame stays on screen (also after the GPU is lost or comes back from a full-screen game), so an assistant at rest presents nothing and costs nothing.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IWindowServices
files.Summary: Moving and changing windows from the assistant process.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.IWorld
files.Summary: The desktop as the host sees it.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.MonitorInfo
files.Summary: A monitor: its bounds, its work area (without the taskbar) and its scaling (1.0 = 100 %).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.MusicBeat
files.Summary: The beat of the music playing ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.OtherAssistant
files.Summary: Another assistant on the desktop ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.PixelRect
files.Summary: A rectangle in physical screen pixels (the virtual desktop: every monitor, whatever its scaling). All the coordinates the SDK hands out or takes are in these units.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Place.Tray
files.Summary: The notification area of the taskbar, near the clock (volume, network, power…).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Place
files.Summary: A place on the desktop a gesture refers to.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.ReactionContext
files.Summary: The context of a , filled by the host.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.ReactionSource
files.Summary: Where a reaction comes from.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Rope
files.Summary: A rope (cable, hook line, leash) simulated with Verlet integration, in screen pixels like everything else. The start is always held (by the assistant); the end hangs free or is held too (stuck in a window, on a projectile). It only resists stretching, so it sags and goes slack, and it never gets longer than while its end is free. It steps itself at a fixed 120 Hz whatever the frame rate, so it behaves the same on any screen.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.ShowcaseGroup
files.Summary: Groups of the showcase for an assistant's own animations ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.ShowcaseItem
files.Summary: One of its own animations, for the showcase: a dance, a trick, the way it plays with a ball… What the host already asks of every assistant (entrances, exits, states, reactions, gestures) is not listed: the host launches those itself. K-Desktop shows these in the assistant's «Try» tab and in the catalog, and asks for one with .

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SpeechText
files.Summary: What it says, for .

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.StateDetail
files.Summary: The detail of a state ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SurfaceLayer
files.Summary: Where a surface goes in the stacking order of the overlay.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemEvent.FastScroll
files.Summary: The user scrolled hard (several quick notches of the wheel), anywhere. Strength 0…1, positive downwards; Position is the cursor's.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemEvent.HourStruck
files.Summary: The clock struck an hour (local time).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemEvent.NotificationShown
files.Summary: A Windows notification (toast) appeared at Bounds.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemEvent.PauseChanged
files.Summary: K-Desktop was paused or resumed.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemEvent.UserIdle
files.Summary: No input for Seconds (raised at 60 s and then every few minutes).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemEvent.WheelTurned
files.Summary: One turn of the mouse wheel, only while the assistant asks for them ().

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemEvent.WindowMoved
files.Summary: A window moved or changed size (raised once it settles, not for every pixel).

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemEvent
files.Summary: Things that happen on the PC, delivered to on the engine thread. They are what lets an assistant react on its own (the Lander jumps when a notification appears, goes to sleep when the user leaves…). is already up to date when one arrives.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.SystemState
files.Summary: What the host knows about the user and the PC right now. Read it at any time from the engine thread.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.TaskbarInfo
files.Summary: The taskbar of one monitor and, on the main one, the notification area and the clock.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.Variety<T>
files.Summary: A set of variants to choose from at random: several entrances, reactions, idle animations or lines, so the assistant does not do the same thing every time. Each variant has a weight (how often it comes up compared with the others) and a cooldown (seconds it rests after being picked). It never picks the same one twice in a row while there is another to choose. Give it a seed in tests to always get the same sequence.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.WindowCommand
files.Summary: What does to a window.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.WindowInfo
files.Summary: A visible top-level window as the window manager sees it.

files.Title: KDesktop.Assistant.Sdk.WorldSnapshot
files.Summary: A picture of the desktop at one moment. Immutable: a new one is made whenever something changes ().
